text:
jamie: Kicking off APAC slice at 23:30 PDT (08:30 SGT). tagging @sasha @lee for capacity thumbs. deploy-bot: started rollout slice=apac version=v2.3.1 slot=slot-7
sasha: quick check — thermal headroom on apac pool? seen a few spikes in the last hour
lee: apac GPU pool has ~18% spare at current concurrency, but hot pods on slot-7. recommend 2m warmup with reduced concurrency for first 10m
maria: can we pin traffic to v2.3.0 for failover if we see latency regressions? we should keep v2.3.0 pinned in eu/us as fallback to avoid cross-region cache mismatch
jamie: yes — plan: start v2.3.1 apac slice with 5% traffic for 10m, monitor p95 latency, error rate, and cost CPU. fallback pin: v2.3.0 in apac local pin too (manual)
sasha: add these rollback triggers to the thread: p95 increase >200ms from baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR memory OOMs on >1 pod
lee: ops command to set initial traffic slice: `/deploy set-traffic --slice apac --version v2.3.1 --percent 5 --warmup 2m`
jamie: running that now
deploy-bot: accepted command by jamie, starting gradual shift. token=tx-9a8b. will post progress every 2m
opsbot: capacity-check: apac-slot-7 avg load pre-rollout=72% CPU, queue=3. primordial KV cache hit 88%
sasha: monitors to watch: /dash/latency/apac-v2.3.x, /dash/errors/apac, /dash/gpu-temp/apac-slot-7
maria: also watch prefix-cache-hit-rate for apac (we saw regressions when model side-caching got evicted last month)
lee: rolling 5% -> 10% after 10m if metrics stable. if any rollback trigger hits, we immediately pin to v2.3.0 and notify.
jamie: 2m update: no alert yet. p95 +30ms, errors 0.2%
deploy-bot: progress update: slice=apac percent=5 -> 5 (steady).
sasha: looks ok on infra side. GPU temps within acceptable range.
maria: i'm posting quick release notes to #release-notes: "v2.3.1: inference kernel tweak for memory locality; expect modest latency improvements; apac staged rollout"
lee: after 20m if stable we do 25% bump, then 50% later tonight local time. keep an eye on billing delta too — set a cost watch alert for the slice
jamie: cost watch: `/billing watch --slice apac --threshold +15% --window 30m`
opsbot: billing alert configured for apac slice threshold +15% over 30m.
jamie: 12m update: p95 +120ms (baseline +90ms), still under threshold. error rate 0.5%
sasha: p95 creeping. remind: our p95 baseline excludes cold-start penalties; ensure dashboard uses rolling baseline
lee: not seeing pod restarts, but one GPU instance in slot-7 shows minor throttling at 11:45 SGT. I've queued a small backfill: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-apac-slot7 --grace-period=30` to rebalance.
maria: agree with restart. if p95 continues to drift, we should trigger controlled rollback.
jamie: decision: if p95 delta >150ms for next 2 windows we pin back to v2.3.0. otherwise proceed with 25% bump after 10m
deploy-bot: noted rollback policy: p95_delta>150ms x2 OR error_rate>1% x1 -> auto-pause and notify-team
opsbot: healthcheck: slot-7 pod-restarts=1, memory-oom=0, gpu-temp=76C (nominal).
sasha: i'm going to hold on plan to widen slice until we hit 20m stable period. please keep alerts loud
jamie: 22m since start: p95 +160ms for latest 5m bin (first threshold breach).
maria: triggering manual pin now
lee: confirm command? `/deploy pin --slice apac --version v2.3.0 --reason "p95 regression"`
jamie: I ran it — pin in place. traffic reverted to v2.3.0. deploy-bot: rollback applied, version pinned v2.3.0 for slice=apac by jamie (tx-9a8b).
deploy-bot: rollout aborted for v2.3.1 in apac. details: p95 delta=165ms, error_rate=0.6%, action=pin to v2.3.0
opsbot: post-rollback capacity: slot-7 load back to 68% within 3m, queue down to 1. caching hit restored to 91%
sasha: good catch. can we collect logs for the v2.3.1 variant for next-gen analysis? specifically model hot paths and KV cache eviction logs
maria: logging note: set long retention for these logs (24h) and add a tag `apac-v2.3.1-failure`
lee: I'll capture heapdumps and perf traces from the affected pods and upload to /artifacts/apac/v2.3.1/replay-<ts>
jamie: retrospective action items: 1) add thermals to rollout gating, 2) increase warmup to 4m for model variants that change kernel selection, 3) enable canary-level prefix-cache warmup step
maria: writing up release postmortem and flagged items in the release checklist. posting link here when ready
sasha: closing this thread: we pinned apac back to v2.3.0, will rework v2.3.1 and reattempt after the fixes. :white_check_mark:
